email_subject: Resolution: Refund Initiated for Billing Issue (INR 1,000) – No Further Action Required
email_body:
Dear Ananya Sharma,

Thank you for bringing your recent billing concern to our attention. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by being incorrectly charged INR 2,499 for your subscription, despite downgrading your plan to INR 1,499 before the billing date.

Following your contact with our customer support team on 12 August, and after reviewing the supporting invoice screenshot you provided, our billing team confirmed that the higher amount was charged in error. We have now initiated a refund of INR 1,000 to your original payment method. Please allow 5-7 business days for the refund to be reflected in your account.

This issue has been fully resolved, and no further follow-up is necessary at this time. Should you need any further assistance or have additional questions, please feel free to reach out.

Best regards,
Service Team
